olivia: Heads-up: we completed the observability-driven tweak to the KV prefetch heuristics + latency-aware batching at 08:07 PT and ramped to 100% after a short canary. Sharing quick post-deploy summary.

deploy-bot: deploy started: commit c2d8b7e -> prod | canary=5% -> 20% -> 100% | sha c2d8b7e | duration 00:16:40

raj: 45m in on full traffic. Topline: p50 -7%, p95 -29%, p99 -21%, cost per 1k tokens -19%. Concrete numbers below.

raj: ```
before: {p50: 88ms, p95: 210ms, p99: 480ms, cost_1k: $0.041} 
after:  {p50: 82ms, p95: 150ms, p99: 380ms, cost_1k: $0.033}
```

marta: Nice work. Any interesting diffs by client type or region?

raj: APAC region saw slightly smaller p95 gains (~18%) due to different traffic mix. Mobile clients (older SDK) showed higher 429 rate during canary but fallback routing mitigated impact.

olivia: Notes on change: prefetch heuristics now consider session continuation probability + recent KV-miss patterns; batching adds a micro-sampling delay window that grows/shrinks with realtime qps (ceiling 10ms). We also disabled a legacy aggressive-merge path that caused occasional batch clumping.

runtime-oncall: infra update: brief queue increase during 20% step (~55s) but normalized; autoscaler added one node for ~3m. No GPU OOMs. two 429s surfaced from clients pinned to old SDK; I've filed INF-9881 for client-compat follow-up.

alerts-bot: alert created: post-deploy-queue-spike | condition: queue_length > 110 for >90s | owner=eng-sre | ticket INF-9882

sophie: product/CS want a single-line blurb and exact metrics to share. Can we prepare a short note that includes caveats?

olivia: Draft shareable: "Typical short-context workloads: ~20% lower inference cost and ~20-30% improved p95 latency. APAC/mobile clients may see different results; long-context improvements are smaller but p99 benefits are noticeable. See internal perf graph and changelog."

raj: uploaded perf charts: https://internal.redwood/perf/graphs/1795001111 (internal only).

marta: Can we run the same canary on Dedicated next week (Thu 09:00 PT) to validate reserved pools and autoscaler behavior?

olivia: Scheduled for Thu 09:00 PT; calendar invite sent.

deploy-bot: deploy finished: commit c2d8b7e -> prod | status=success | duration=00:27:12 :rocket:

runtime-oncall: continuing 48h watch and will revert if p99 > baseline for 15m. thanks team, great cross-team response! :tada:
